question: What practice should be maintained continually when the yoginī assembly takes place?
premises: The consumption should occur at all times.
The context is the assembly of yoginīs.
inference: One should always consume that when there is an assembly of yoginīs.
uncertainties: The referent of tat depends on the preceding context.
plain_english: One should always drink that; there may be an assembly of yoginīs.
